label: notify
definition: The provider must notify the Commission without delay and within two weeks after meeting a specific requirement or knowing it will be met.
source_quote: the relevant provider shall notify the Commission without delay and in any event within two weeks after that requirement is met or it becomes known that it will be met

label: take the request into account
definition: The Commission must consider a reasoned request from a provider regarding a model designated as having systemic risk.
source_quote: Upon a reasoned request of a provider whose model has been designated as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk pursuant to paragraph 4, the Commission shall take the request into account

term: General-Purpose AI Model with Systemic Risk
label: general-purpose AI model with systemic risk
definition: A general-purpose AI model designated by the Commission as presenting systemic risks.
source_quote: the general-purpose AI model shall be considered to be a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk
